title: Accounts Executive - Finance & Accounts
description:
WE ARE HIRING – ACCOUNTS EXECUTIVE

**Industry:** Product-Based Company  
**Department:** Finance & Accounts  
**Experience:** 2–3 Years  
**Qualification:** B.Com / M.Com  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a responsible and detail-oriented Accounts Executive to manage day-to-day accounting activities, invoicing, statutory filing, documentation, and auditor coordination. Candidates looking for a stable, long-term career opportunity are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

* Prepare sales invoices, purchase invoices, credit notes, and debit notes.
* Maintain day-to-day accounting records and ensure accurate data entry.
* Handle accounts payable, accounts receivable, and payment follow-ups.
* Perform bank and ledger reconciliations.
* Maintain proper filing of invoices, bills, vouchers, and financial documents.
* Assist with GST returns, TDS filings, and other applicable statutory compliances.
* Coordinate with external auditors and provide the necessary documents for audits.
* Assist with monthly account closing and preparation of financial reports.
* Verify vendor invoices and coordinate payment processing.
* Ensure timely updating and accuracy of accounting records.

Required Qualifications

* B.Com / M.Com or an equivalent qualification in Commerce or Accounting.
* 2–3 years of relevant experience in accounts and finance.
* Working knowledge of invoicing, accounting procedures, GST, and TDS.
* Basic proficiency in MS Excel.

Added Advantages

* Knowledge of **Zoho Books or Tally**.
* Previous experience working in a **CA or auditor’s office**.
* Experience in a product-based, trading, or distribution company.
* Practical exposure to GST returns, TDS filing, and audit documentation.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Candidates with a stable employment history and a long-term career outlook.
* Ability to independently handle routine accounting activities.
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and numerical accuracy.
* Good communication and coordination skills.

**Interested candidates may share their updated resume for consideration.**

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Analyst, Revenue Accounting
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

  
  
  

**Group/Division**

KLA is known for its high-performing business model. Our Finance organization, comprised of Operations and Corporate Finance teams, delivers expert guidance to develop and execute sound business practices. Operations Finance teams use analytics, modeling and data tracking to shape business decisions. Corporate Finance's spectrum of services includes internal and external financial reporting, accounting, taxes, industry analysis, benchmarking, internal audits, and merger and acquisition support.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

  
  

* Support KLA’s global revenue team in ensuring compliance with policies and regulations, driving process improvements, enabling an efficient and effective function.
* Managing Revenue Accounting Activities
* Revenue Accounting in line with US-GAAP and local requirements including revenue forecast, reconciliations, reporting and assisting with SOX controls request.
* Working closely with corporate revenue team, divisions accounting and finance team for timely revenue booking and tracking.
* Working with SAP IT finance team to fix any issue in SAP reporting modules, specifically RAR to ensure accurate reporting and accounting, while eliminating the need for any manual intervention
* Driving improvement and Automation projects across Revenue Accounting.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* B. Com, semi-qualified/qualified professional (CA/ICWAI) with minimum 10+ years of overall experience.
* Experience in SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting module preferred.
* Fair understanding of US-GAAP.
* Proven track record of handling revenue accounting activities, driving process improvement, and implementing financial systems, processes and technologies.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional and geographically dispersed team.

**About KLA**

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

  
  

**Use of AI Statement**

At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.

  
  

*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*

  

*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

title: Senior Executive - Finance
description:
**About Rocketlane**

Rocketlane is a fast-growing, innovative SaaS company making waves in professional services automation (PSA) and customer onboarding.

Our mission? To empower B2B companies with a smooth, consistent, and efficient way to manage client projects, resources, time, and billing—reducing chaos and boosting customer satisfaction across industries.

We’re a close-knit team of 150+ passionate professionals, building a product teams love to use. Backed by top investors like Insight Partners, 8VC, Matrix Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners, we’re scaling fast—and now’s the perfect time to join the rocketship.

**What will you do?**

As a Senior Executive – Finance, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring financial accuracy, compliance, and efficiency across our India and US operations. You will manage critical finance functions while working closely with internal teams, auditors, and external stakeholders.

Here’s what you’ll get to do:

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date books of accounts in compliance with applicable accounting standards. Collaborate with external consultants to ensure timely monthly closure of accounts, and oversee the preparation of MIS reports to support business decision-making.

* Ensure full compliance with statutory requirements under Indian laws including Income Tax, Companies Act, FEMA, and GST. This involves timely filings, accurate tax computation, monitoring regulatory changes, liaising with consultants/authorities as needed, and implementing robust internal controls to mitigate compliance risks.

* Oversee compliance with US financial regulations including sales and use tax, payroll tax, and related reporting obligations. Work closely with external advisors and payroll providers to ensure timely filings, accurate withholding, and adherence to state and federal laws.

* Oversee the administration of vendor contracts, manage the end-to-end process of invoice verification, approval, and payment.

* Act as the primary liaison with statutory auditors by providing all necessary documentation, explanations, and information.

**You should apply if**

* You have qualified CA/ACCA with 2–5 years of experience in finance or accounting, preferably in a SaaS or multinational environment.

* You possess strong knowledge of Indian taxation, compliance, and accounting standards, along with exposure to US compliance requirements.

You are detail-oriented, analytical, and adept at managing end-to-end finance operations. You are comfortable working with accounting software and ERP systems.

* You communicate clearly, work collaboratively across teams, and can manage multiple priorities with ease.

**Why join us?**

At Rocketlane, we’re all about building a great product and a great place to work. Here’s why you’ll actually look forward to Mondays:

* **Impact and ownership**: You won’t just be another cog in the machine; here, you’re more like a turbocharged engine part. Bring your ideas, make them happen.

* **Work with the best**: We’re a team of passionate, quirky, and ridiculously talented people. Come for the work, stay for the memes.

* **Celebrate wins**: Whether we’re hitting major milestones or celebrating new funding, we like to mix it up. From rap videos to team outings, we believe in celebrating big.

* **Learn and grow**: We’re all about learning—and we’re not just talking about the latest SaaS trends. You’ll grow your career, pick up new skills, and maybe even learn to love Excel (or at least tolerate it).

* **Flexibility and balance**: While we love collaborating in the office five days a week, we know everyone has their own rhythm. That’s why we offer flexibility around hours—so you can bring your best energy, whether you’re an early bird or a night owl. Pajamas optional (at least outside the office).

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
Senior Financial Analyst  

  

ICON is a global healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation united by a mission to bring new medicines and treatments to patients faster.

  

  

As a values\-driven organisation, integrity, collaboration, agility, and inclusion are at the heart of how we work and interact with each other, customers, patients and suppliers.

  

  

As a Senior Financial Analyst at ICON, you will provide critical insights to support strategic decision\-making and drive financial performance across the organization.

  

  

**What You Will Do:**

You will take ownership of finance and financial management deliverables, applying your expertise to complex challenges.
  

  

Key responsibilities include:


* Conducting comprehensive financial analysis, including variance analysis, forecasting, and budgeting, to support business planning and decision\-making.
* Developing and maintaining financial models to analyze trends, assess financial performance, and project future financial outcomes.
* Preparing and presenting detailed financial reports and recommendations to senior management, highlighting key findings and actionable insights.
* Collaborating with cross\-functional teams to gather data, understand business drivers, and provide financial support for various initiatives and projects.
* Monitoring financial performance against budgets and forecasts, identifying discrepancies, and proposing corrective actions as needed.
* Ensuring accuracy and consistency in financial reporting and analysis, and maintaining a strong understanding of accounting principles and financial regulations.
* Staying current with industry trends, best practices, and regulatory changes to continuously improve financial analysis and reporting processes.
  

  

**Your Profile:**

You will have a strong foundation in finance and financial management, with the experience to work independently and guide others.
  

  

Required qualifications and experience:


* Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business administration, or a related discipline
* Extensive experience as a financial analyst, with a strong background in financial modeling, analysis, and reporting.
* Proficiency in financial analysis tools and software, including advanced Excel skills; experience with ERP systems is a plus.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial data and provide actionable insights.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex financial information clearly and effectively to stakeholders at all levels.
* Exceptional organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
  

  

Employment with ICON is contingent upon having the legal right to work in the country where the role is based.

  

  

**Rewards \& Benefits**

ICON offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and career development.

  

  

Benefits may include:


* Competitive base salary and performance related incentives
* Health and wellbeing programmes including medical, dental, and vision coverage where applicable
* Retirement and pension plans
* Life assurance and disability coverage
* Employee assistance programmes and wellbeing resources
* Learning and development opportunities through structured training and career pathways
  

  

Benefits may vary depending on role and location.

  

  

Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers.

  

  

**Inclusion and Accessibility**

ICON is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive and accessible workplace where everyone feels valued and supported.

  

  

If you require reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know or submit a **request** .

description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**Tax Operations Senior Analyst:**


Are you looking for a career move that will put you at the heart of a global financial institution? Then bring your skills in analysis, communication to Citi’s Tax Operations team.


By Joining Citi, you will become part of a global organization whose mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress.


**Team/Role Overview:**


We are seeking a skilled Tax Operations Analyst to join our Europe Wealth Client Tax Operations team in Warsaw, Poland. Citi Wealth offers unmatched global reach, coupled with a full range of portfolio management and investment advisory services, an array of structured lending and banking services, as well as expertise from Citi's Markets and Banking division.


This role is critical for maintaining and advancing client tax operations in Europe cluster withholding Taxes \& Custody services such as tax reclaims, Relief at source within Poland. The successful candidate will conduct in\-depth analysis of complex global client booking models, security services, perform reconciliations, identify operational risks, and ensure compliance with local tax regulations.

ensuring complete, accurate and timely payments \& tax form filing to local tax authorities.


This position also requires interaction with Business Management, Business Risk \& Control, Legal and Compliance teams, and external stakeholders, making it essential to have a seasoned professional in this role.


**Responsibilities:**


* Ensure compliance with local tax regulations, including the preparation of account reconciliations for revenues and VAT/GST tax accounts for all legal vehicles within Citi Wealth International clusters
* Prepare non\-US tax reports covering multiple jurisdictions and products, including quarterly reconciliations and Swiss withholding taxes (e.g., Swiss FTT Form 9, Local withholding, and VAT)
* Expertise in Tax Reclaim services, including Quick Refund and Relief at Source processes. Evaluating eligibility and preparing required documentations and ensuring compliance with local and international regulations. Navigate complex tax systems and provide guidance on maximizing eligible refunds

* Provide first\-level support for inquiries from client advisors regarding the Tax Reclaim Service and handle the preparation and transmission of data files to custodians
* Support the global implementation of Tax projects while contributing to strategic tax programs and technical implementations
* Analyze tax transaction withholding processes from front to back and implement operational changes arising from process remediations or enhancements in collaboration with Business Change management \& Technology partners.
* Streamline process inconsistencies, mitigate risks, and maintain comprehensive process documentation, ensuring knowledge sharing across the team for effective tax operations and control functions
* Ensure timely escalation of issues, track their resolution, and participate in governance forums
* Collaborate closely with Business and Technology partners to identify gaps and drive process improvements

**Qualifications:**

* 5 to 10 years of experience
* A good track record of experience in a tax\-related area and good understanding of tax reporting and operational tax processes
* Good understanding of Cash \& Stock Reconciliations
* Swift notifications knowledge \- MT599, MT546, MT568, MT566 as an asset
* Corporate actions \& income payments experience in EMEA and US markets
* Experience in Tax Operations/ Tax Reclaims and/or Tax Technology organizations
* Knowledge about the Double Tax Treaty Agreements, International Taxation, Custody Operations, Relief at source and reclaim
* Experience in Tax Operations (Direct/Indirect Tax, Withholding TAX, Goods and Services Tax, Trading Tax etc.)
* Good understanding of Investments and capital market products as well as trade execution and settlement processes
* Strong multi\-tasking, organizational and time management skills with experience in continuously following up with various stakeholders and execution teams
* Ability to take initiative, self\-motivate and consistently demonstrate a results\-driven mindset
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to conduct detailed analyses of complex tax processes
* High level of integrity and ability to handle sensitive and confidential information in compliance with Swiss client data privacy laws
* Critical thinking and drawing logical conclusions
* Experience working both independently and, in a team\-oriented, collaborative environment

**Education \& Skills:**


* Bachelor's/University degree or equivalent experience, preferably in finance and banking
* Fluent English: Ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing in a concise and coherent manner with international clients and bankers. German speaking is an added plus
